data.one_liner: Automatically gets mobile device proxy settings and configures HTTP traffic.
data.what_it_does: Gets proxy settings of a mobile device automatically and sets up proxy routing for HTTP requests. It allows developers to easily inspect network traffic using tools like Charles proxy.
use_when: You want to debug HTTP requests with proxy tools like Charles on mobile devices
You need to automatically capture mobile device proxy settings
avoid_when: You do not need to debug network traffic using local proxies
You are looking for a complete networking client
strengths: Simplifies routing HTTP traffic through proxy debugging tools
weaknesses: Limited platform support to Android and iOS
Not documented for advanced custom proxy configurations beyond automatic fetching
data.setup_notes: Initialize via HttpProxy.createHttpProxy() and assign to HttpOverrides.global before runApp().

alternatives.name: http
alternatives.why_pick_it: A standard, widely used HTTP client for Dart which this package integrates with for proxy routing.

alternatives.name: dio
alternatives.why_pick_it: A powerful HTTP client for Dart, which has built-in support for interceptors and proxy configurations.
